name: Owner quality console
description: Shows the Quality & Operations console in Settings for the platform owner.
hypothesis: A visible quality console increases the share of releases that carry a published gate run.

name: Paywall value framing
description: A/B test: a factual value badge above the Premium plan versus the current plan card alone.
hypothesis: Naming the four concrete Premium outcomes beside the price lifts checkout starts without reducing completion.

name: Daily review cap
description: Remote config for how many due cards a Daily Review serves (default 5).

name: Engineer auto-guardrails
description: Allows the engineer agent to pause experiment rollouts when reliability floors are breached, and to record the action for approval review.

name: M-Pesa premium checkout
description: Offers Safaricom M-Pesa (Daraja STK Push) as a Premium payment method on Android. Off until the Daraja secrets and mpesa_checkouts migration are live.
hypothesis: A local payment rail converts Kenyan learners who cannot pay through store billing.
